name: Glassmorphism
blurb: Frosted translucent panels over a saturated colour field, with hairline light borders and a soft top-edge highlight.

name: Brutalism
blurb: Raw type, hard 3px rules and offset block shadows, one acid accent, nothing rounded and nothing softened.

name: Swiss Style
blurb: Strict twelve-column grid, Helvetica, asymmetric whitespace and a single red accent doing all the emphasis.
